title: The Card in the Wallet
description:
Cleaning out the wallet — a business card.

Lee Minseo. The woman who owns the Gangnam apartment.

'If you want to know how I did it, reach out.'

Months since she said that.

choices.text: Send the message — ask to meet
choices.result_text:
'you've been waiting. Let's get coffee.'

Fast reply.

A card that sat in a wallet for three months finally got used.

choices.text: Not yet — not ready to stand in front of her
choices.result_text:
Wants to show up with something to show.
Not empty-handed.

Put the card back. Still there when it's time.

title: When the Goal Disappears
description:
Something Minseo said keeps coming back.

'When you have a goal — prepare for when it disappears.'

Made no sense back then — what it meant that the ₩3 billion would vanish the moment you had it.
Lately you think you're starting to understand.

choices.text: Think about what comes after ₩3 billion
choices.result_text:
'If I hit the number — then what?'

Uncomfortable question. The goal had been the engine.
Without it: who am you?

Minseo must have been talking about this. Now it makes sense.

choices.text: Not there yet — focus on the goal first
choices.result_text:
That's a problem for a later version of {name}.
Get there first.

But her expression when she said it — 'that's the hardest part' — doesn't fully leave.
